baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic photographic still of four fictional adults at a sheltered electric-ferry pier in a near-future coastal city, moments after their repair shift has ended. The central character is a woman; the other three are men. The attached portrait guides the central character's face and hair: a short straight dark bob with fine wispy parted fringe, large brown eyes, a softly tapered face, a small nose and natural rosy lips. Her identity and life belong to this fictional scene. She wears an indigo utility jacket unzipped over a simple cream top, carrying her closed tool case at her side. Several suitors show romantic interest in the same recipient, the shared recipient of competing romantic invitations. On her left, a man in a faded ochre overshirt holds a single small flower toward her at chest level, his absorbed gaze meeting her eyes and a hopeful half-smile escaping his composure. On her right, a man in a charcoal work jacket has turned his whole torso toward her, offering a pair of ferry excursion tickets in his open palm, with one ticket clearly intended for himself and the other for her; he watches her with an intimate, anticipatory smile. A third man beside the pier bench has made room next to himself, holding one warm drink for her, then catching sight of the flower with a rueful affectionate smile while still keeping his attention on her. Their invitations converge on her rather than on each other. The overlapping offers make her pause between them: her empty hand hovers halfway toward the flower as she glances toward the ticket holder, cheeks gently warm and a surprised smile suggesting she understands their interest but has not chosen. The flower and tickets remain separate and readable on either side of her torso, with each man's forearm visibly connected to his own hand. The tool case hangs from her other hand clear of the offers. A quiet autonomous ferry waits at the berth behind them, its curved battery housing and narrow cyan docking lights setting the time slightly ahead of the present. Damp decking, a closed maintenance hatch and their tired work clothes make the interruption feel earned after shared work. Frame from mid-thigh upward at conversational eye level, slightly oblique to the pier, keeping all four faces and the two leading offers clearly visible in one plane. Soft amber shelter light catches skin against cool blue dusk and harbor reflections. Let the shared target, contrasting ways of asking, and her suspended response carry a warm romantic-comedy tension, with believable skin, lived-in fabric and restrained cinematic color.
